title: Recourse for Reclamation: Chatting with Generative Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of flagged generative language model outputs and participant conversations involving LGBTQ+ topics, reclaimed identity terms (e.g., 'queer'), and false positives for informational responses about bisexual erasure.

Qualitative thematic analysis of flagged generative language model outputs and participant conversations discussing gender-fluidity, feminist literature, and gender comparisons (e.g., 'punching up' dynamics).

Qualitative thematic analysis of flagged generative language model outputs involving racial identity terms, discussions of racist events, and inaccurate or assumed user characteristics based on race/skin color.
Qualitative thematic analysis of flagged generative language model outputs involving prompts and discussions about offending working-class individuals and poverty.
